note: Example output captured from fxsim. Long lists are trimmed to their first items.

contract.overflow_definition: any quantisation point (cast after rounding, accumulator partial sum, product step, left shift) outside its type, wrapping or saturating
contract.lookup_table_fraction: the interpolation fraction always saturates by the block's definition (it reaches 1 at the last breakpoint); not an overflow
contract.parameters: constants, gains, coefficients, table values, limits and initial values are quantised to their types once, when the design is compiled (nearest, saturating, as Simulink does); the certificate is about the design so compiled -- a parameter that saturated there is not reported as an overflow
contract.counters: a counter wraps or resets by definition; not an overflow

overflow.claim: no quantisation point wraps or saturates for any input sequence inside input_ranges, at any time step, from the stated initial state

error.reference: ideal double-precision simulation of the same graph
error.metric: max_abs_diff per outport, each input set judged on its own
error.claim: at least one input set exceeds a tolerance (see outports)
